turns.user: Show me published prints similar to an 800 mm high wall printed with a 25 mm nozzle and 15 mm layers.
turns.text:
I’ll look for published wall prints with similar height, nozzle size, and layer height, and highlight any differences.
The similarity tool requires a layer cycle time or wall length, which you haven’t specified. I’ll query the published print records directly using the dimensions you gave.
The closest retrieved match uses **the same nozzle diameter and layer height**, but the printed wall is shorter. No exact match to all your dimensions appeared in the retrieved records.

| Published print / mix | Height (mm) | Nozzle diameter (mm) | Layer height (mm) | Reported outcome |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| [RBA-3DPC Mix 2—cavity-wall façade](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clema.2022.100090) | 390 | 25 | 15 | Printable |
| [RBA-3DPC and PCM-3DPC façade sections](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2023.136247) | 390 | 25 | 15 | Both printable |
| [Printed concrete wall—Table 1 mix](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cscm.2024.e02892) | 800 | 15 | 10 | Printable |
| [ISTON wall mix](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2024.136574) | 600 | 50 | 15 | Printable |
| [H-3 wall buildability test](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.141735) | 730 | 20 | 10 | Collapsed during a stack-to-failure test |

**Best process analogue:** the RBA-3DPC façade used a print speed of **60 mm/s**, a layer path of **5,032 mm**, and a reported layer cycle of **84 s**. Its cavity-wall geometry matters when comparing stability with your wall.

The H-3 result is a failure-height reference, not a successful wall demonstration. These database-extracted published results do not establish your wall’s buildability; wall geometry, material behaviour, and printing schedule still require verification.

I interpreted your nozzle size as a circular diameter; no mix or schedule defaults were assumed.

Retrieved height-comparison records: [CSV](</C:/Users/User/3D Printing Concrete Prediction/artifacts/reports/agent/20261016-171341-c074/sql_1792138463.csv>).

sample.notes: Buildability test (R1/R2) and single-filament nozzle-diameter test (R4/R5) matched to test_uid T2 (merged 'other' family test covering buildability, CO2 uptake, BET and interfacial bending; see record unmapped_terms UM3). Rheology thixotropy (3-step shear rate 0.1/100/0.1 s-1) and shear-thinning sweep (0.1-150 s-1) protocols are described only qualitatively in the paper (percent recovery, relative stiffness) and are NOT captured as a test row in the record (extraction_notes T6: figure series not digitised) - both rheology_protocols rows carry test_uid: null. shear_rate_s1 left null for the flow-curve-fit sweep because it spans a range (0.1-150 s-1), not a single stated rate. No print speed (mm/s) or layer cycle time is stated anywhere in the accessible text. R4/R5 (single-filament nozzle test) report a nozzle-diameter range (2-21 mm) rather than a single run setting; run-level nozzle diameter fields are not part of this schema (only printer.nozzle_d_mm, set to the 4.8 mm nozzle used for the main structures) so the range is described in the quote instead. No units required conversion.

No rheology (yield-stress/viscosity/Athix) test protocol reported; ink flow properties are only described qualitatively ('proper flow properties... shape holding'), no instrument/protocol named, so rheology_protocols is empty and matches the record's test list (flexural only). print_speed_mm_s converted from 250 mm/min to mm/s by /60 (=4.17). Pitch angle for the smallest Bouligand category is given as psi=2 degrees in the introductory list of architectures but as psi=8 degrees in the Results paragraph reporting pitch angles studied (8,15,30,45,90); likely an OCR/typo discrepancy in the source text, both values are quoted verbatim, neither is treated as authoritative. No print failures, buildability tests, or stack-to-failure trials are reported anywhere in the paper; all printed architectures proceed directly to post-cure mechanical testing, so all runs are labelled printable on the general author statement that these elements were 'achieved by 3D-printing'. The figures directory for this paper contains only manuscript text page scans (page_01..page_41.png); no distinct figure graphics with captions were found in the 3 pages sampled (pp. 2, 17, 18), so figures did not add information beyond the body text.

No printing experiment reported: the paper investigates carbon-fiber-tape reinforcement 'for' 3D concrete printing but the four-point-bending test specimens (series 1-4) were cast in moulds per DIN EN 12390-2 ('The production and storage of the test specimens is carried out according to the standard DIN EN 12390-2'), not additively manufactured; no printer, nozzle, or print settings are mentioned anywhere in the text. The record's only test (T1, flexure_four_point) is a hardened-concrete mechanical test, not a fresh-state rheology test, so rheology_protocols is empty; no yield-stress/viscosity/Athix test is reported for the fine-grained concrete mix either.

input.sql: SELECT r.paper_uid,r.run_id,r.mix_name_in_paper,r.object,r.height_achieved_mm,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.nozzle_d_mm,''),NULLIF(p.nozzle_d_mm,'')) AS nozzle_d_mm,r.layer_height_mm,r.outcome,r.printability_label,r.stack_to_failure,r.source_locator,r.quote,r.source_discrepancy FROM print_runs r LEFT JOIN printers p ON r.paper_uid=p.paper_uid WHERE LOWER(r.object) LIKE '%wall%' AND CAST(r.height_achieved_mm AS REAL)>0 AND CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL)>0 AND CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.nozzle_d_mm,''),NULLIF(p.nozzle_d_mm,'')) AS REAL)>0 ORDER BY ABS(CAST(r.height_achieved_mm AS REAL)-800)/800.0 + ABS(CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.nozzle_d_mm,''),NULLIF(p.nozzle_d_mm,'')) AS REAL)-25)/25.0 + ABS(CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL)-15)/15.0 LIMIT 10

input.sql: SELECT r.paper_uid,r.run_id,r.mix_name_in_paper,r.height_achieved_mm,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.nozzle_d_mm,''),NULLIF(p.nozzle_d_mm,'')) AS nozzle_d_mm,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.nozzle_w_mm,''),NULLIF(p.nozzle_w_mm,'')) AS nozzle_w_mm,COALESCE(NULLIF(r.nozzle_h_mm,''),NULLIF(p.nozzle_h_mm,'')) AS nozzle_h_mm,r.layer_height_mm,r.outcome,r.stack_to_failure,r.source_locator FROM print_runs r LEFT JOIN printers p ON r.paper_uid=p.paper_uid WHERE LOWER(r.object) LIKE '%wall%' AND CAST(r.height_achieved_mm AS REAL) BETWEEN 600 AND 1000 AND CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL)>0 ORDER BY ABS(CAST(r.height_achieved_mm AS REAL)-800)/800.0+ABS(CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL)-15)/15.0 LIMIT 8
